statistics.cardDescription: qui records the upload and download of each torrent in its database. These settings apply to all instances.

recording.label: Record transfer history
recording.description: While this is off, qui records nothing and keeps the stored history. The time while it is off becomes a recording gap.

retention.label: Keep daily detail for
retention.description: After this time, qui folds the hourly totals into days, and the daily bytes of each torrent into one row for each year. The totals stay the same. When you select a shorter time, qui folds the older detail at the next reading, and you cannot get it back.

deleteHistory.label: Delete history
deleteHistory.description: Delete the transfer history of one instance or of all instances. You cannot get it back.
deleteHistory.confirmEverything: qui deletes all the history of {{name}}. Recording starts again with a new baseline. You cannot undo this.
deleteHistory.confirmBefore: qui deletes the history of {{name}} before {{date}}. If recording started before that date, the bytes from before the first recording go too, and "Recording since" moves to that date. You cannot undo this.
deleteHistory.sqliteSpace: The database file keeps its size. SQLite uses the free space again for new history.
deleteHistory.postgresSpace: A delete of everything of all instances gives the space back to the disk at once. After another delete, Postgres uses the free space again for new history.

shrink.label: Also shrink the database file
shrink.restart: qui restarts and makes the file smaller, so you get the disk space back. qui is unavailable for a short time.
shrink.nextStart: qui cannot restart itself on this install. The shrink runs at the next start of qui.
shrink.tooLittleSpace: The disk has {{free}} free, and a shrink needs up to {{need}}. It is safe to leave this off: SQLite uses the free space again for new history.
